name: CitcoOne

web.notes: Client Login on citco.com points to citcoone.citco.com, which redirects to an OAuth2/OIDC authorization flow at login.citco.com (application name CitcoOne). MFA not stated publicly.

api.notes: No API mentioned on Citco investor pages.

notes: Citco's proprietary investor and client platform (high confidence). Features per Citco: interactive dashboards and workflows, order placement, document management, fund details, dynamic reporting, capital activity monitoring. January 2025 update added online capital transaction instructions with e-signature. Used for online PE capital commitments (600+ in 10 days at one close, per Alternatives Watch). Separate Citco Credit Portal (2026) for loan servicing.
